description: Create or update a defect: with `id` it updates, without it creates, and then `title`, `actual_result` and `severity` are required. Severity and status are labels ("blocker", "open"…), mapped for you. For a defect born from a specific test failure use qase_triage_defect; search with qql_search before filing a duplicate. Cost: one API call, about 0.5s.

actual_result.description: What actually happened — required when creating a defect

id.description: Defect ID — if provided, updates; if omitted, creates

severity.description: How bad the defect is — required when creating a defect

status.description: Set to "resolved" to resolve the defect

name: qase_defect_upsert
title: Create or update defect
